headline: Backend Developer diving deep into the oceans of distributed architectures and high-level system design.

experience.title: Tradeforces: Distributed HFT Benchmarking System
experience.summary: Engineered an 8-microservice evaluation platform, utilizing Kata Containers and AWS Firecracker to provision hardware-isolated microVMs in 200–300ms with strict CPU pinning. Automated runtime image compilation via Google Cloud Build and dynamic K3s pod generation, enforcing strict pod affinity to perfectly co-locate evaluation workloads. Developed a microsecond-precision Go Telemetry Gateway (7-goroutine pipeline) to dispatch raw FIX protocol orders over TCP. Used complex state-mapping data structures to track single-trade lifecycles and calculate execution latency. Architected a high-throughput event pipeline leveraging Redpanda for strict order serialization and GCP Pub/Sub for decentralized worker queues and dynamic backpressure management. Tech Stack: Go, FastAPI, React, GCS, Cloud Build, Redpanda, Pub/Sub, Postgres, Kubernetes (K3s), Docker, Terraform.

experience.title: Ping: Distributed Real-Time Messaging System
experience.summary: Engineered Ping, a real-time messaging system, by evolving a monolithic design into a scalable microservices architecture that decouples the main API from the connection manager. Developed a co-locating FastAPI and gRPC servers in a single Python application to share memory for Websocket objects. Architected a Distributed system, enabling horizontal scaling with a Dynamic Nginx Load Balancer for the gateway and Redis for the replica mapping and finding active replicas. In a high-concurrency k6 Load test with backend deployed as a multi-replica in a multi-instance setup, the system handled 8000 concurrent virtual users and P95 latency of 198ms on 6000 vus on a 5-core infra with Redis and Postgres GCP services. Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, gRPC, Redis, ws, Postgres, k6, AWS, GCP, Nginx, CI/CD, PgBouncer, Docker Swarm, Terraform.

experience.title: AI-Powered Relocation Survey Management System
experience.summary: Digitalized the village relocation workflow, with the CV stage detection and a 4-step verification pipeline for transparency. Built an AI chatbot for real-time dynamic data analysis and visualization by plain-English queries, where the LLM generates pseudo-queries routed through a validator layer to enforce role-based authorization and enhanced security. Tech Stack: React, Flutter, Python, Flask, MongoDB, OpenCV, AI/LLM Integration.
